submit_steps: 1 Open /submit No account. The page opens on the price: submissions start at $20, paid once. An optional Product Hunt import at the top fills the form from a PH link.

gotchas: There is no free submission any more: the listing costs $20 once, and paying does not skip the manual review.
The $20 listing does not include the dofollow link. That is a separate $100 one-time purchase, five times the price of the listing.
They say listings go up within 24 hours, but every one is still reviewed by hand.
Their footer discloses affiliate links across the site, so read the neighbourhood before deciding it is your audience.
